title: Dragon Egg World
description: A large spherical dragon egg covered in green moss, grass, and stone-like scales sits against a dark teal background. A jagged crack reveals a glowing golden interior with a baby dragon's clawed hand and scaly arm emerging from within.
prompt: A large spherical dragon egg covered in lush green moss, grass, ferns, and overlapping stone-like scales with dew drops, cracked open to reveal a glowing warm golden interior where a baby dragon's green scaly hand and arm are emerging, set against a solid dark teal background, highly detailed fantasy painting
